import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Amount by Transaction Type (Bar chart)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
type_amounts = df.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(type_amounts))
bars = ax1.bar(type_amounts.index, type_amounts.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Amount by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars, type_amounts.values):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 10, 
             f'${val:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# Plot 2: Transaction Count by Type (Pie chart)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(type_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie,
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(type_counts), shadow=True)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Distribution by Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Amount Distribution by Hour of Day (Scatter plot)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
scatter = ax3.scatter(df['hour_of_day'], df['amount'], 
                      c=df['transaction_type'].astype('category').cat.codes,
                      cmap='viridis', s=150, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add legend for transaction types
for i, t_type in enumerate(df['transaction_type'].unique()):
    ax3.scatter([], [], c=[plt.cm.viridis(i/len(df['transaction_type'].unique()))], 
                label=t_type, s=100)
ax3.legend(title='Transaction Type', loc='upper left')

# Plot 4: Amount Distribution (Box plot and individual points)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=ax4, palette='pastel')
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=ax4, 
              color='darkblue', size=8, alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Amount Distribution by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
